description: Re-run a work item: terminate its current crew and dispatch a fresh one that reuses the same feature branch (lands new commits on the existing open PR) and re-reads the company's current agent config, so updated skills/guardrails take effect. If the prior crew record is missing, retry recovers by using the work item and initiative dispatch defaults. Returns the new crew id. If the item is DONE/DROPPED this fails with `terminal_item` — reopen it first via anyforge_update_work_item action='reopen'. Requires `write` scope.
name: anyforge_retry_work_item
title: Retry work item
